changed_from_v2: cycle term re-encodes through the REAL encoder: the prompt is rebuilt with the x field replaced in place, right-aligned, by the soft digits of Dec(h_t), so gradient reaches Enc and Enc is trained on intermediate residues (ballistic_depth.forward_soft_digits on the evaluator format). ReEncoder and its grounding term dropped. Cycle/re-entry masked to rows whose decoded residue width equals the x-field width, so Enc's input distribution is exactly the test distribution. Ramp gated on an EMA of train exact-match crossing 0.5 (clock fallback 60%), ramping over the next 15% of clock, instead of a fixed 15-45% clock window.
